## Model Links

Files this workflow loads. Put them in the sub-folders shown below so the loaders find them without re-selecting.

**diffusion_models**

- [Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_v2_pruned_int8.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/WarmBloodAban/Minimax-h3_Singularity/blob/main/Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_v2_pruned_int8.safetensors) (Singularity v2 fine-tune of H3 Ref2VA)

- ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel: [ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel/issues](https://github.com/penguinhelmet/ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel/issues)

The camera performs a smooth medium-shot tracking movement, with golden city lights and the illuminated Eiffel Tower behind her, accompanied by sophisticated deep-house fashion music with a refined 105 BPM groove.

[2s-4s] On a strong musical beat, a flowing sweep of champagne silk passes across the lens, creating an elegant fabric-wipe transition into a magnificent marble interior. The same woman now wears an ivory off-shoulder couture gown, walking slowly past a grand column before turning toward the camera. A subtle dolly-in captures her confident expression, diamond earrings, and luxurious natural skin texture under soft golden lighting.

[4s-6s] A precise beat-synchronized match cut transforms the ivory setting into the glamorous entrance of a five-star Parisian hotel. The model now wears a sculptural black satin evening gown, walking confidently toward the camera with a small designer clutch. The camera tracks backward at a consistent medium-full distance while chandeliers and polished marble surfaces create beautiful cinematic reflections.

[6s-8s] A graceful whip-pan following her shoulder reveals a grand golden staircase, where she appears in a dramatic deep burgundy couture gown with a flowing train. She descends two steps elegantly, one hand gliding along the ornate railing as the camera makes a subtle upward tracking movement. Her silk dress flows naturally, illuminated by sparkling chandeliers.

[8s-10s] As the burgundy fabric sweeps across the foreground, a seamless match cut reveals a private luxury art gallery. The model wears an elegant ivory draped couture gown and walks slowly past monumental stone sculptures, her posture graceful and confident. The camera glides sideways in a sophisticated medium fashion shot, emphasizing the movement of her dress and the architectural surroundings.

[10s-12s] A smooth reflection transition reveals the model in a luxurious dressing suite, wearing a black velvet evening gown. The camera moves gently around an ornate gilded mirror as she delicately adjusts her diamond earring, her reflection maintaining perfect facial consistency. Warm golden highlights illuminate her face while the music continues uninterrupted.

[12s-13.5s] A cinematic match cut transitions into the covered entrance of an exclusive Parisian hotel at night. Wearing an espresso-brown silk gown with a long cashmere coat draped over her shoulders, the model walks elegantly away from a black luxury limousine. The camera tracks beside her in a medium shot as wet pavement reflects golden hotel lights, accompanied by subtle footsteps and distant city ambience.

[13.5s-15s] On the final musical accent, a smooth cinematic transition reveals the model in a dramatic black couture gown standing before a panoramic Paris skyline. The camera gently pushes toward her as she slowly turns over her shoulder, her long brown hair catching a soft golden rim light. She holds a powerful, sophisticated fashion-editorial gaze as elegant serif typography reading "MAISON ÉLITE" appears in the negative space beside her, ending on a luxurious cinematic hero portrait with a refined musical finish.

nodes.title: Note: Speed settings (ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel)
widgets_values:
## Speed settings (ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel)

Measured on the R9700, 10 s clip: **618 s → ~310–325 s** back-to-back, same character (face check vs the reference image).

### Changes from 01-Minimax_H3_Latent-Upscale-I2V_R2V
- **Load Image 1**: resize to max 1 MP (reference tokens ride through every step)
- **Model Sparse Attention**: sol-attn tau 1.5 (was 1.0); 2.0 changes the picture
- **Stage-1 preview** decode/save muted
- **Latent upscaler** 2D fp16 (3D runs out of VRAM)
- **Final resolution** 1.0 MP (was 1.5)
- **UNET**: Singularity v2 pruned int8

### ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel nodes
- **Text Encoder BF16** (after Load CLIP): runs the text encoder's language model in bf16 instead of fp32. Encode 42 s → 12 s. Same weights file.
- **Load VAE (BF16)** (above Stage 2, feeds only the final VAE Decode): decode 43 s → 34 s, 47 dB vs the original.
  - `fast_rms_rope`: Triton RMSNorm+RoPE kernel (-3.2 s)
  - `fast_convrot_quant`: Triton ConvRot int8 quantizer (-1.9 s)
  - The reference-image encode keeps the normal Load VAE, so the clip's composition is unchanged.

All of them work with any H3 diffusion model / LoRA. If something looks wrong after a ComfyUI or comfy-kitchen update, switch the toggles off (or set enabled = false): everything falls back to the stock kernels.

### Steps
BasicScheduler steps = total; SplitSigmas step = stage-1 steps (at least 6, 8+ for better audio); the rest go to the stage-2 upscale (at least 4). This workflow: 12 total, 10 + 2.

### Reference inputs (MiniMax H3 Reference to Video)
- Images: ≤ 9
- Video: ≤ 3 clips, 2–15 s each, ≤ 15 s total
- Audio: ≤ 3 clips, 2–15 s each, ≤ 15 s total; only together with image or video inputs
- At most 12 files in total

### Low VRAM
UniBlockSwap Low VRAM (bypassed, in Load Models) lets this run on ~8 GB of VRAM, much slower. Not needed on 32 GB.
